Week 8

Fit and compare AR, MA, ARMA, and ARIMA models using both manual and automatic approaches.

Prepare before class

Read Sections 9.3 to 9.8 of FPP3 and be ready to compare different ARIMA specifications.

Seminar and workshop

Wednesday 29 April · Seminar 3:00pm to 3:50pm, workshop 4:00pm to 4:50pm · Building K Level 3, K321

## What you will learn this week * AR, MA, ARMA and ARIMA models * Selecting model orders manually and automatically ## Pre-class activities Read [Sections 9.3-9.8 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima.html) and watch all embedded videos ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives 1. **Fit and compare ARIMA forecasting models**. - Able to use ARIMA() (with transformations where needed) to select an appropriate model, generate forecasts, and compare them against alternative specified ARIMA structures. 2. **Evaluate model adequacy using residual diagnostics**. - Check whether ARIMA model residuals resemble white noise (including examining autocorrelation in residuals) and use this evidence to refine or justify model choice. 3. **Translate between model equations and ARIMA notation**. - Recognise ARIMA model equations in algebraic form and correctly express them using ARIMA $(p,d,q)$ notation. ::: - Complete Exercises 7, 8, 15 (a to c), 16 (a to c) from [Section 9.11 of the book](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima-exercises.html). ## Assignments * [GA3](../assignments/G3.qmd) is due on Tuesday 05 May. * [IA4](../assignments/A4.qmd) is due on Friday 15 May. ## Weekly quiz * Week 8 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400154) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5402237) — Due Wednesday 29 April.
